chapters.name_zh: 处理器、并行处理与虚拟机
chapters.name_en: Processors, parallel processing and virtual machines

types.name_zh: 用户定义类型的概念与分类
types.name_en: User-defined data types: purpose and classification
types.summary: 说明为什么需要用户定义类型；解释组合（composite）与非组合（non-composite）类型；描述枚举、指针、集合、记录各是什么；列出组合类型的种类；说明枚举值列表的特征；在给定记录里挑出适合做枚举的字段并给理由。不写声明语句。
cues: Describe the purpose of a user-defined data type
Explain what is meant by non-composite and composite data types
State what is meant by the term enumerated / pointer data type
Describe the user-defined data type set / record
Identify two other types of composite user-defined data types
Identify one field … that could be an efficient enumerated data type and give a reason
not: P3-DR-02 / P3-DR-03 / P3-DR-05：要写出 TYPE 声明语句 → 写声明的题型；本题型只用文字回答
P3-FP-04：class / object 作为 OOP 术语来问（实例、封装等）→ FP-04；只把 class 列为一种组合类型时留在本题型
P2-DT-01 / P2-DT-04：AS 的内置数据类型选择与数据结构选择，不涉及用户定义类型的分类

types.name_zh: 声明与使用枚举类型和指针类型
types.name_en: Declaring and using enumerated and pointer types
types.summary: 按伪代码指南写 TYPE <名> = (值1, 值2, …) 定义枚举类型、TYPE <名> = ^<类型> 定义指针类型；把记录里某字段改为该枚举类型（DECLARE Gate : GateID）；包括枚举 / 指针类型本身的声明与单独使用。给记录字段赋值（含赋枚举值，不加引号）一律归 DR-04。
cues: Write pseudocode to create an enumerated type called …
Write the pseudocode statement to declare a non-composite data type … that holds the following data
Write pseudocode to create a pointer type called … / to declare a pointer data type called … to be used with STRING data
Write the new pseudocode statement required to replace / update the declaration of … in the definition of …
Write the new pseudocode statement to assign house to BuildingGroup
not: P3-DR-05：TYPE … = SET OF … 与 DEFINE → DR-05
P3-DR-03：要写整个 TYPE … ENDTYPE 记录 → DR-03（记录里某字段用了枚举类型，副题型不加，除非有得分点专门给枚举声明）
P3-DR-01：只问枚举/指针是什么、有何特征 → DR-01

types.name_en: Declaring a record (composite) type
types.summary: 根据数据描述写 TYPE <名> … ENDTYPE，逐个 DECLARE 字段并选对类型（编号、电话用 STRING，日期用 DATE，题目给的枚举类型名作字段类型）；也包括改写类型定义里的某一行（范围 1 .. 10、数组字段）。
cues: Write pseudocode statements to declare the composite data type … to hold data about …
Write pseudocode statements to declare the record data type …
Define, using pseudocode, the composite data type …
Use the most appropriate data type in each case
Write the updated line of pseudocode from the type definition of …
not: P3-DR-04：类型已定义好，要声明一个记录变量或给字段赋值 → DR-04
P3-FP-06：CLASS … ENDCLASS（有方法、PRIVATE 属性）→ FP-06
P2-DT-02：AS 卷的同类写法；P3 的行一律用 P3 题型

types.name_zh: 记录变量的声明与字段赋值
types.name_en: Declaring a record variable and assigning to its fields
types.summary: 为已定义的记录类型声明一个变量（DECLARE Flight1 : Flight），用点号给字段赋值：字符串加引号、日期按 dd/mm/yyyy 不加引号、布尔写 TRUE/FALSE、枚举值不加引号。
cues: Write the pseudocode statement to set up a variable for one record of the composite data type …
Write pseudocode to store the details of the following … in the variable you set up
Write pseudocode statements to assign: … to … of …
Write the pseudocode statements to assign the following values to the variable set up in part …
not: P3-DR-03：要写 TYPE … ENDTYPE 本身 → DR-03
P3-DR-02：只给字段赋一个枚举值、且该小问是在改用枚举类型的题组里 → 仍按本题型；若小问要写 TYPE … = (…) → DR-02

types.name_en: Declaring a set type
types.summary: 按伪代码指南写 TYPE <类型名> = SET OF <基类型> 与 DEFINE <集合名> (值, …) : <类型名>；字符要加单引号。核验语料 2 次（w24、s24），考纲点名 set，单独保留。
cues: Write pseudocode statements to declare the set data type … to hold …
… using the variable …
SET OF / DEFINE
not: P3-DR-02：TYPE … = (…) 是枚举类型，不是集合；题干说 "a data type to hold a set of prime numbers" 但 MS 给的是枚举写法时按 MS 归 DR-02（9618_s23_31:4(a)）
P3-DR-01：只描述集合类型是什么 → DR-01

types.name_en: Methods of file organisation
types.summary: 描述、比较串行（serial，按到达先后）、顺序（sequential，按键字段排序）、随机（random，按散列地址）三种文件组织方式；举出各自适用的例子；为给定情境选择组织方式。
cues: Describe how records are organised in serial / sequential / random files
Compare sequential and serial methods of file organisation
Describe sequential and random methods of file organisation
State one example of where serial / sequential / random file organisation could be used
not: P3-DR-07：问怎样找到/存取一条记录（sequential access、direct access）→ DR-07
P3-DR-08：问散列算法或冲突 → DR-08
P3-FP-10：写文件处理伪代码 → FP-10

types.name_en: Methods of file access
types.summary: 描述顺序存取（从头逐条比较；顺序文件比到键值大于目标即停）与直接存取（顺序文件用索引、随机文件用散列）；说明它们怎样应用于串行、顺序、随机文件；为给定情境选存取方式；概述在某种文件里找一条记录的过程。
cues: Describe the sequential method of file access
Outline what is meant by direct access as a method of file access
Explain how the sequential method of file access is applied to files with serial organisation and … sequential organisation
Explain how direct access is used to locate a specific record in sequential files and random files
Outline the process that would be used to find a record in a random / serial file
State the most suitable method of file access when …
not: P3-DR-06：只问记录在文件里怎样组织、用在哪里 → DR-06；「organised and accessed」两者都问时按得分点多数
P3-DR-08：题目本身问散列算法、散列值或冲突 → DR-08；问「随机文件怎样直接存取/找记录」仍归本题型（散列是直接存取的手段），有得分点讲冲突处理时加副题型 DR-08

types.name_en: Hashing algorithms and collisions
types.summary: 用给定散列函数（常为 MOD n）算出记录键的散列值；解释散列算法在直接存取中的作用；说明冲突（collision）是什么、存取时冲突怎样处理（顺序找下一个空位、溢出区）。
cues: A hashing algorithm is used to calculate storage locations for records in a random access file
Complete the table … hash value
Explain what is meant by a hashing algorithm in the context of file access
Outline what is meant by the term collision / Explain how a collision can be dealt with
Describe what happens … when the calculated hash value is a duplicate
not: P3-DR-07：问怎样在随机文件或顺序文件里直接存取/找记录 → DR-07（见指南 §7 第 3 条）
P3-FP-10：写用 SEEK/GETRECORD 处理随机文件的伪代码 → FP-10

types.name_en: Converting a binary floating-point number to denary
types.summary: 给定补码尾数与补码阶码，求它的十进制值：先算阶码，再按阶码移动二进制小数点，最后按补码求值（负尾数最高位为负权）。MS 常为 2 分过程 + 1 分答案。
cues: Calculate the denary value of the given (normalised) (binary) floating-point number
Show your working
Mantissa … Exponent … Working … Answer / Denary value
not: P3-DR-10：方向相反，十进制 → 浮点 → DR-10
P3-DR-11：求最大/最小可表示数、把给定位串规格化 → DR-11
P1-IR-03：AS 的补码整数换算，没有阶码

types.name_zh: 十进制写成规格化浮点数
types.name_en: Converting a denary number to normalised floating point
types.summary: 把带符号的十进制数（含小数）写成指定位数的规格化浮点数：先转二进制（负数取补码），再移动小数点使尾数以 01 或 10 开头，阶码用补码；必要时说明位数不够造成的精度损失。
cues: Calculate the normalised (binary) floating-point representation of –102.75 in this system
Write the normalised floating-point representation of +202 in this system
show how it would be represented in each of these two systems
Show your working
not: P3-DR-11：给的是二进制数（如 0101010.111 或未规格化的位串）而不是十进制数 → DR-11
P3-DR-12：只解释表示时出了什么问题、不要求写出表示 → DR-12（同题组中各自归类）

types.name_zh: 规格化与可表示的最大最小值
types.name_en: Normalisation and the range of normalised values
types.summary: 把给定的二进制数或未规格化的浮点位串写成规格化形式；说明给定数为什么不是规格化的；说明规格化的理由（精度最大、表示唯一）；写出最大正数、最小（最负）数并给出十进制（可用 2 的幂表示）。
cues: Write the normalised floating-point representation of the following (positive / unsigned) binary number using this system
The given binary floating-point number is not normalised. Normalise the floating-point number
State why the number is not normalised
Explain the reason why binary numbers are stored in normalised form
Write / Give the largest positive (normalised) two’s complement binary number that can be stored in this system
not: P3-DR-10：给的是十进制数 → DR-10
P3-DR-12：问改变尾数/阶码位数的影响、溢出下溢、近似 → DR-12

types.name_zh: 精度、范围、舍入误差与上溢下溢
types.name_en: Precision, range, rounding errors, overflow and underflow
types.summary: 解释改变尾数与阶码位数分配对精度与范围的影响；解释为什么某数不能精确表示（尾数位不够、0.2 这类小数无法精确表示）及后果；说明何时发生上溢、下溢及其后果；为了精确存储某数应怎样改变位数分配。
cues: Describe the effect of changing the allocation of bits used for the mantissa and for the exponent
Explain the problem that occurred / will occur in storing …
Describe the reason why the normalised form of the following binary number cannot be represented accurately
Explain why a binary representation is sometimes only an approximation to the real number
State when underflow occurs / Describe one example of a situation that could cause an overflow
State the consequence of storing … Justify your answer
not: P3-DR-10 / P3-DR-11：要写出具体的浮点位串 → 写表示的题型；本题型只用文字解释
P1-IR-05：AS 的整数加法溢出

types.name_zh: 协议的必要性与协议栈
types.name_en: Why protocols are needed; protocol stacks
types.summary: 解释计算机通信为什么必须有协议；说明协议实现可视为分层的栈、各层只与相邻层交互；描述一条消息从一台主机经互联网发到另一台主机时 TCP/IP 栈怎样被应用（逐层下传、加报头、对端逐层上传）；完成关于协议栈的选词填空段落。
cues: Explain why a protocol is used / Outline why protocols are essential for communication between computers
Describe how the layers of the TCP/IP protocol stack interact with each other
Describe how the TCP/IP protocol suite is applied when a message is sent through the internet from one host to another
Do not describe the function of individual layers
Complete the following paragraph … using words from the given list
not: P3-CI-02：要写出各层名称、顺序或某一层的功能 → CI-02
P3-CI-03：问具体应用层协议（HTTP、IMAP 等）→ CI-03
P1-CM-09：AS 的互联网基础设施（URL、DNS 等）

types.name_zh: TCP/IP 四层的顺序与功能
types.name_en: TCP/IP layers: order and functions
types.summary: 写出或排好 TCP/IP 四层（Application、Transport、Internet、Link）的顺序；描述某一层或两层的目的与功能（传输层分包、排序、端到端、重传；网际层加 IP 地址、路由；链路层成帧、MAC 地址、在直连设备间传送）；把各层与描述连线。
cues: Complete the diagram to show the correct order for these layers
Describe the function / purpose of the Transport / Internet / Link layer
Outline the functions of the Transport and Internet layers of the TCP/IP protocol suite
Identify two (other) layers of the TCP/IP protocol suite (and describe the function of each)
Draw one line to connect each TCP/IP layer to its most appropriate description
not: P3-CI-01：问层与层之间怎样交互、一条消息怎样经过整个栈（明说不描述单层功能）→ CI-01
P3-CI-03：应用层题目问的是具体协议（HTTP、FTP、SMTP…）→ CI-03；问应用层本身的目的与功能 → 本题型

types.name_en: Application-layer protocols: HTTP, FTP, POP3, IMAP, SMTP
types.summary: 说出应用层协议的名称与用途；收发电子邮件用哪些协议（发送 SMTP，接收 POP3 / IMAP）；描述 IMAP 等某个协议的作用；把协议与用途连线。
cues: Identify two protocols used by this layer. Describe the use of each protocol
Name and describe two protocols used by the Application Layer
State the names of two different protocols associated with the sending and receiving of emails
Describe the purpose of the IMAP protocol / State the purpose of the HTTP and IMAP protocols
Draw one line to connect each protocol to its most appropriate use
not: P3-CI-04：只问 BitTorrent 怎样共享文件 → CI-04（连线题里 BitTorrent 只占一条线时仍归本题型）
P3-SC-04：SSL/TLS 协议 → SC-04
P3-CI-02：问应用层这一层的目的与功能 → CI-02

types.name_en: BitTorrent peer-to-peer file sharing
types.summary: 解释 BitTorrent 怎样实现点对点文件共享：torrent 文件、tracker、swarm、文件分块、同时从多个 peer 下载并上传（seed / leech）。核验语料 2 次，考纲 14.1 点名，单独保留。
cues: Explain the meaning of the phrase: BitTorrent protocol provides peer-to-peer file sharing
Describe how files are shared using the BitTorrent protocol
not: P3-CI-03：多个应用层协议一起问（含连线题）→ CI-03
P1-CM-02：AS 的客户机-服务器与点对点网络模型比较

types.name_en: Circuit switching
types.summary: 描述电路交换（先建立专用线路、整段带宽独占、按序到达、传完拆除）；给出好处与缺点；说明在什么场合适用并给理由。
cues: Describe circuit switching as a method of data transmission
Give / State two benefits and two drawbacks of circuit switching
State, with a reason, where it would be appropriate to use circuit switching
not: P3-CI-07：同一小问里同时问电路交换与分组交换（比较、各自的好处、区别）→ CI-07
P3-CI-06：只问分组交换 → CI-06

types.name_en: Packet switching and the router
types.summary: 描述分组交换怎样在网络（含互联网）上传消息：分包、报头（源/目的地址、序号）、各包独立选路、到达后按序重组、校验与重发；给出好处与缺点、适用场合；说明分组交换怎样保证收到完整消息；描述路由器在分组交换中的作用（读目的 IP、查路由表、定下一跳、跳数减 1）。
cues: Describe / Explain how packet switching is used to transmit / pass messages across a network / the internet
Give / State two benefits and two drawbacks of packet switching
State two examples of where it would be appropriate to use packet switching
Describe two ways in which packet switching ensures a complete message is received
Describe / Outline the function of a router in packet switching
not: P3-CI-07：与电路交换比较 → CI-07
P1-CM-04：AS 的数据包在某种拓扑中怎样走

types.name_zh: 电路交换与分组交换的比较
types.name_en: Comparing circuit switching and packet switching
types.summary: 同一小问里同时考两种交换方式：分别描述并各给一个优点、缺点；写出两者的区别；各给一个好处。
cues: Describe both methods of data transmission. Include a different advantage and disadvantage for each method
Give four differences between circuit switching and packet switching
Identify one benefit of circuit switching and one benefit of packet switching
Identify two differences between circuit switching and packet switching
not: P3-CI-05 / P3-CI-06：只问其中一种 → 对应题型

types.name_zh: RISC 与 CISC 处理器
types.name_en: RISC and CISC processors
types.summary: 描述 RISC 与 CISC 的特征（指令少而简单、定长、单周期、硬连线、寄存器多、便于流水线 vs 指令多而复杂、变长、多周期、微程序）；写出两者区别；在表格里勾选某特征属于 RISC 还是 CISC。
cues: Describe what is meant by RISC and CISC processors
Identify two differences between RISC and CISC processors
Identify four features of a RISC / CISC processor / State two features of RISC processors
Tick one box in each row to show if the statement applies to RISC or CISC processors
not: P3-HV-02：问流水线、或 RISC/CISC 的中断处理 → HV-02
P1-PF-01 / P1-PF-05：AS 的 CPU 部件与性能因素

types.name_en: Pipelining and interrupt handling
types.summary: 描述 RISC 中流水线的作用（指令分为五个阶段、各阶段在同一时钟周期并行处理不同指令）；补全流水线时钟周期图；概述 RISC/CISC 的中断处理过程（周期结束时检测、寄存器入栈、执行 ISR、恢复）；解释流水线使中断处理变复杂的原因与做法。
cues: Describe the use of pipelining in Reduced Instruction Set Computers (RISC)
Describe the process of pipelining during the fetch-execute cycle in RISC processors
The processing of instructions is divided into five stages … Complete the diagram
Outline the process of interrupt handling as it could be applied to RISC or CISC processors
Explain how pipelining affects interrupt handling for RISC processors
not: P3-HV-01：只问 RISC/CISC 特征与区别 → HV-01
P3-SY-03：OS 内核作为中断处理程序、低级调度 → SY-03
P1-PF-04：AS 的中断概念

types.name_zh: 四种基本计算机体系结构
types.name_en: The four basic computer architectures (SISD, SIMD, MISD, MIMD)
types.summary: 说出并描述 SISD、SIMD、MISD、MIMD（单/多指令流 × 单/多数据流，各举一例）；比较其中两种的异同。
cues: Identify the three other categories of computer architecture. Describe each category
Describe the features of SISD and MIMD / SIMD and MISD computer architectures
State one difference and one similarity between the SIMD and MISD computer architectures
not: P3-HV-04：问大规模并行计算机的特征 → HV-04

types.name_en: Massively parallel computers
types.summary: 概述大规模并行计算机的特征：大量处理器或独立计算机通过网络连接、同时协同处理同一任务的不同部分、各自有内存、通信开销。核验语料 2 次，考纲 15.1 独立要求。
cues: Outline / Describe the characteristics of massively parallel computers
not: P3-HV-03：Flynn 四类体系结构 → HV-03

types.name_en: Virtual machines
types.summary: 解释虚拟机是什么（在宿主机上用软件仿真另一套硬件/系统，运行客户操作系统）；给出用途与好处（试用新系统、多个 OS 共存、运行旧软件、隔离安全）和局限（性能差、难以测量、受宿主影响、实现复杂）；说明宿主操作系统与客户操作系统的角色。
cues: Explain / Describe what is meant by (the term) virtual machine
Describe two benefits and one limitation of using a virtual machine
Outline two benefits and two limitations of a virtual machine
Explain the roles of the host operating system and the guest operating system
not: P3-SY-04：虚拟内存（virtual memory）→ SY-04，名字相近但无关

types.name_zh: 由逻辑电路完成真值表
types.name_en: Completing a truth table from a logic circuit
types.summary: 给出逻辑电路（可有三输入门、中间结点 P、Q、R、S），逐列算出中间结点与输出，完成真值表；MS 常给 1 分「working」（中间列）+ 按行块给输出分。也包括由给定表达式的电路完成真值表。
cues: Complete the truth table for the given logic circuit. Show your working
Working space … P Q R S Z
This logic circuit represents the Boolean expression … Complete this truth table
not: P3-BL-04：由真值表写积之和表达式 → BL-04
P3-BL-02：在真值表之后问电路名称（半加器、全加器）与输出用途 → BL-02
P1-LG-04：AS 的真值表题；P3 的行一律用 P3 题型

types.name_en: Half adders and full adders
types.summary: 认出给定电路是半加器或全加器；说明各输出的用途（和位 Sum、进位 Carry）；可要求写出各输出的积之和表达式。核验语料 2 次（s22），考纲 15.2 点名，单独保留。
cues: State the name of this logic circuit
State the purpose of each output
Write the Boolean expressions for the two outputs … and state the purpose of each output
not: P3-BL-01：同题组的真值表 → BL-01
P3-BL-04：只写表达式、不问加法器 → BL-04

types.name_en: Flip-flops (SR, JK)
types.summary: 用两个 NAND 或两个 NOR 门画 SR 触发器并标输入；说明触发器的作用（存储 1 位）；考纲还要求 JK 触发器及触发器真值表，语料尚未出现。核验语料 2 次（w22）。
cues: Draw a logic circuit for an SR flip-flop and label the inputs
State the purpose of a flip-flop
not: P3-BL-01：一般组合逻辑电路的真值表 → BL-01

types.name_zh: 由真值表或电路写积之和表达式
types.name_en: Writing a sum-of-products expression from a truth table or circuit
